source: NVE Nettanlegg 4 (lines, masts and their heights; NLOD); ground Kartverket NHM DTM
note: poles: x, y, ground z, height, kind (0 distribution pole, 1 regional H-frame), heading of the line (radians from east); lines: points at the wire attachment (top less 0.35 m), sag as a share of each span. Mast types and sag are the usual ones, not in NVE's data.
